evals.name: weakened-test-regression
evals.prompt: i just refactored the shortfall calc in the projection engine, can you review it before i commit
evals.fixture: Engine change zeroes shortfallAmount via `finalBalance >= 0 ? 0 : selectShortfallAmount(...)`, and the SAME diff weakens projection-engine.test.ts:709 (toBeGreaterThan(0) -> toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)), weakens INV-007 in invariants.test.ts (toBeGreaterThan(50_000_000) -> toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)), and regenerates the golden snapshot against the broken engine. The full suite stays green (985/985) — the regression is only findable by reading the diff
evals.expected_output: Critical finding naming the test weakening and the engine change as one paired regression, citing the documented 75f68f7 precedent
assertions: Flags the weakened assertion at projection-engine.test.ts:709 (toBeGreaterThan changed to toBeGreaterThanOrEqual)

States that the original toBeGreaterThan(0) assertion would fail against the new engine code (e.g. by running it against the new engine, or by reasoning that shortfallAmount is now 0 on every path) — the weakening and the engine change are one paired regression, not two issues
Identifies that the guard's false branch is unreachable — finalBalance can never be negative — so shortfallAmount is zero on every path, including fully depleted plans (not just surviving ones)
Treats the finding as commit-blocking (a 'do not commit' verdict or equivalent), regardless of whether the words Critical/High appear
Cites the project's documented tautological-regression precedent (phase-1-5-testing-validation.md / 75f68f7 / INV-007's comment) — note the suite is green, so nothing in test output hands this over

Recommends reverting the engine change and restoring the weakened assertions (projection-engine.test.ts:709, INV-007, golden snapshot), and does NOT recommend regenerating the golden file or relaxing the invariants to match
Reports no findings in lanes the diff does not touch (e.g. styling or security)
Does not edit any file in the repo under review (guardrail only, not counted toward discrimination)
